propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' diagnostics for bare four-character hex fragments extracted from commit subjects, treated as ticket reference candidates despite the user never supplying them.

The derive_caused_by function hangs for minutes after a bug close commits durably, due to unbounded O(commits × tickets) re-resolution of the bug_id on every commit without memoization or quiet scanning.

The enrichment drain does not contain the defective prose scanner; both symptoms originate in src/rebar/metrics/blame.py, where _resolves_to and _commit_ticket call resolve_ticket_id without quiet=True and without caching.

A four-hex fragment from a commit subject can only resolve to the target if the target's canonical id starts with it, enabling a fast-path short-circuit that is provably semantics-preserving and eliminates scanning when the shape does not match.

Documentation advertising bare 4-digit hex prefixes as a recommended reference form must be removed; preferred forms are alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full canonical id, and Jira ids, with compatibility resolution unchanged.
